rubric.note: MVP appeal = visual presentation 40%, interaction feel 30%, playable loop 20%, clarity 10%. Delivery timing is shown independently because comparable build timestamps are incomplete. Scores are reviewer judgments of these artifacts, not benchmark measurements or student grades. Critical device bugs remain release blockers regardless of MVP score.
